description: Net worth, total assets, and total liabilities from comma separated asset and liability values, with optional matching names for the largest asset and liability. Only positive values count, as on the page. Use when the user lists assets and debts and wants their net worth. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive net worth calculator.

asset_names.description: Asset names, comma separated, in the same order as asset_values.

asset_values.description: Asset values in USD, comma separated, in the same order as asset_names.

liability_names.description: Liability names, comma separated, in the same order as liability_values.

liability_values.description: Liability values in USD, comma separated, in the same order as liability_names.

name: calculate_net_worth

calculator_url.description: Deep link to the matching interactive calculator on everycalc.xyz.

inputs.description: The normalized inputs the calculation used.

results.description: The computed figures for this calculator.

tool.description: Name of the tool that ran.
